title: Rakhi Ray & Ors. v. High Court of Delhi & Ors.
bench: K.G. Balakrishnan CJI, Deepak Verma aur Dr. B.S. Chauhan, JJ. (faisla: Dr. B.S. Chauhan, J.)
summary: Delhi mein District Judge ki 20 vacancies vigyapit hui (13 General, 3 SC, 4 ST). General ki 13 bhar gayi. Select list mein neeche wale umeedwaron ne baad mein bani vacancies par niyukti maangi.
held: Vigyapit sankhya se zyada niyukti Article 14 aur 16(1) ke khilaaf hai, "a nullity, inexecutable and unenforceable in law" (para 14). Vigyapit post bharte hi chayan prakriya khatam ho jaati hai, aur waiting list aage ki vacancies ka bhandaar nahi (para 14–15). Reservation lagu karne ke liye vacancies ki sankhya pehle tay honi chahiye (para 24). Appeals dismissed.
use: Para 9 aur 14: 18 vigyapit post ke badle 53 niyuktiyan isi siddhant par seedhe galat.
Para 24: reservation policy ke liye vacancies pehle tay karna zaroori. Isse 18 mein ST ki ek bhi post na hone ka sawaal judta hai.
Para 13: Mukul Saikia ka hawala: "the State cannot appoint more than the number of posts advertised".
caution: Para 9 hi kehta hai ki "rare and exceptional circumstance" mein policy decision lekar chhoot sambhav hai. State yahi kahegi.
Para 26: select list mein naam se niyukti ka adhikaar nahi banta. Yeh petitioners par bhi laagu hai, agar unka daawa khud niyukti ka hai.
